name: denmark-vat-return
cost: The skills and the AI connection are free. Skill content is under the OpenAccountants Guide License
works_with: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf or any MCP client. Or upload the files to your AI
short: Danish VAT rules for 2026 for your AI, with every rate, threshold and deadline cited to the law.
what: This skill covers Danish VAT (moms) and the VAT return for 2026. It includes the 25% rate and zero-rated supplies, the DKK 50,000 registration threshold, the EU SME scheme, filing periods and deadlines, input VAT limits, reverse charge, the return boxes, digital bookkeeping and the DKK 1,400 late fee. Each figure links to its official source, and it ends with worked examples and questions to ask the client first.
who: Business owners, bookkeepers and accountants dealing with Danish VAT. It doesn't cover income tax, company tax, payroll, OSS returns or margin schemes, so skip it for those.
needs: An AI app that supports MCP connectors, or one where you can upload files

steps.title: Add the hosted connector
steps.text: Add this URL as a connector in your AI app. There is a guided setup at openaccountants.com/connect.

steps.title: Or run the MCP server yourself
Or upload the files
steps.text: Download Denmark's folder from `packages/` in the repo and upload the files to your AI. The skill file itself is in `agent-skills/denmark-vat-return/`.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: Ask what your Danish VAT return deadline is for the next quarter, and check that the answer cites the law.

watch: This version is a source-cited draft that no accountant has reviewed yet. Have a qualified professional in Denmark check anything before you file or pay.
With the hosted connector, your questions go to openaccountants.com.
Rates and deadlines change. The skill says to confirm every figure against the cited official pages.
